chapters.title: I. The Royal Audience
chapters.narration: In Alsperia, the wizard Algoreth Jon Goren seeks the lost scrolls of Byzantem. Edmon, the kingdom's original king, and his wife, Queen Alisande, may know the road to Lorian.

beats.speaker: Archivist Mara
beats.text: Dorian the Seer was the scrolls' last keeper. He went west through Mistwood. The Caverns of Lorian hold the scrolls, but the old trail is lost.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: A map, a horse, and a night's shelter are yours. Bring back knowledge that may aid Alsperia.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Power travels with obligation, Master Goren. Remember whose trust opens this road.

chapters.title: II. Through Mistwood
chapters.narration: The royal map carries Algoreth into Mistwood. Old waystones promise a safe route, while unseen watchers stir beyond the trees.

beats.speaker: Scout Tessa
beats.text: I know this road. The moss hides snares; follow the pale stones and keep your spellbook ready.

beats.speaker: Tessa
beats.text: These tracks circle us. Something from the ruins hunts travellers after dusk.

beats.speaker: Dorian's inscription
beats.text: The path between worlds answers neither conquest nor fear. Carry a question worth the crossing.

chapters.title: III. The Caverns of Lorian
chapters.narration: Within Lorian, an ancient Byzantem arch guards a silver chest. Dorian's warning follows Algoreth into the dark.

beats.speaker: Dorian the Seer
beats.text: I kept the scrolls hidden from kings and thieves alike. Tell me why you would open a way to another world.

beats.speaker: Dorian
beats.text: The chest is protected by an old guardian. It knows no ambition, only the duty to keep the door closed.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The silver lid yields. The scrolls of Byzantem hold the secret of world travelling. Algoreth carries them back toward Alsperia.

chapters.title: IV. Return to Alsperia
chapters.narration: Algoreth returns from Lorian with the scrolls. King Edmon and Queen Alisande receive the wizard who travelled under their protection.

beats.speaker: King Edmon
beats.text: You found what you sought. Our map and horse carried you west; now tell us what Lorian has taught you.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Knowledge won in darkness deserves careful study. Alsperia will hear your account before any court decides what comes next.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: The scrolls speak of travel between worlds. Their meaning will take time to master; for now I owe this court an honest account.

chapters.title: V. The Eastern Academy
chapters.narration: Much later, Algoreth is Wizard King of Alsperia. Alisande is now his wife and co-ruler. The surviving record leaves the years between their early court and this reign unwritten. Magister Vael reports a disturbance beneath the eastern academy.

beats.speaker: Magister Vael
beats.text: Before dawn, the old observatory annex changed. Light bent, glyphs shifted, and voices answered from the sealed lecture vault.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: The wardens will hold the perimeter. Go carefully, my love. Whatever speaks below already knows your voice.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: A false version of me waits inside the Tear. I will give the breach a boundary instead of feeding it more force.

beats.speaker: Algoreth
beats.text: Power shall endure only in form. Form shall endure only in purpose. Purpose shall endure only where being does not devour itself.

chapters.title: VI. The Living Record
chapters.narration: The Tear of Chaos is sealed, and the false Algoreth remains within it. The king, Alisande and Ealdrin descend to the Deep Archives to learn whether other Tears exist.

beats.speaker: Ealdrin
beats.text: The living record has no title. It speaks of extraordinary powers questioning their limits, and something that answers the question.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: If the Tear has a counterpart, we need scholars, warders and maps before we leave. I will not let you face it alone.

beats.speaker: Ealdrin
beats.text: An archive account warns that forcing a Tear shut can make the sealer its anchor. We should compare the signs in Eldrador.

chapters.title: VII. The Eldrador Expedition
chapters.narration: Queen Vaelthira of Eldrador has found another unstable Tear in her lower sanctuary. Algoreth and his companions prepare an Aethercraft to investigate. What awaits them there remains unknown.

beats.speaker: Queen Vaelthira
beats.text: Our sanctuary's Tear speaks with a familiar voice. I ask you to see it, not to destroy it blindly.

beats.speaker: Seraphina Everglow
beats.text: I have the ward diagrams ready. Your Majesty, the Aethercraft can carry the court's instruments and scholars.

beats.speaker: Alistair
beats.text: The vessel is ready. The magic knights will guard the academy while you are away.

beats.speaker: Queen Alisande
beats.text: Eldrador has invited us. We go together, and we return with the truth we can find.
